intervention_execution.claim: R68 exact fixed filter executed with frozen numerics; identity/parity checks passed.

intended_intermediate.claim: Protected Born mass increased in aggregate; semantic nuisance removal was not observed.

observable_output.claim: Complete40class confusion outputs changed, including recoveries and harms.

task_utility.claim: Role-protected filter decreased development Macro on all10Q/realheads; not an independent population or whole-family finding.

trace_adequacy.selection_rule: Reuse original R68 fixed cohort/hashfold and aggregate summaries; no new outcome-selected cases.
trace_adequacy.target_boundary: Gold/error strata motivate a hypothesis, never choose inference thresholds or formaltest examples.
trace_adequacy.notes: No paired CaseStudy was manufactured. Candidate trace predictions are prospective, not materialized evidence.

primary_explanation.statement: The fixed geometric protection rule was not sufficient for useful task routing; it may suppress useful context.

alternative_explanations.statement: Frozen-head coadaptation and the chosen subspace can explain damage without identifying semantics.

discriminating_measurement.uncertainty: Whether input-specific entity–context compatibility adds useful routing information beyond contextualH and score calibration.
discriminating_measurement.measurement: Freeze a bounded train-only association and later matched-training design with token-square/classical/summary-mismatch controls.
discriminating_measurement.primary_outcome: Correct entity conditioning improves predeclared outputs and exceeds matched controls.
discriminating_measurement.alternative_outcome: No detectable association at declared sensitivity, or matched/mismatched controls explain the effect.

forbidden_rescue_variants: Treat high frequency as measured nuisance without evidence.

positive_carryovers.mechanism: Original trained routing-to-value alignment has scoped task utility.
positive_carryovers.transport_constraint: Retain circuit-derived routing and signed readout, but a changed representation inherits no oldL4.

selected_candidate.title: Entity-conditioned quantum preparation
selected_candidate.causal_difference: Replace fixed background filtering with cross-input entity–word features before wordstate preparation; no filter/transport/outcome retune.
selected_candidate.discriminating_measurement: Samefeatures/budget classical and token-square controls, with same-split ID-blind mismatched summaries, full40class outputs.
selected_candidate.success_gate: First obtain an exact bounded premise/implementation contract; subsequent genuine performance and mechanism gates must pass independently before formal eligibility.
selected_candidate.kill_condition: Stop the exact candidate on a fatal implementation/premise failure; a weak short screen alone does not reject all training-dependent conditioning. NoL5 if only known feature engineering remains.
selected_candidate.authorization_boundary: Exploratory design only now; no model job launched. Exact implementation review/scheduler before bounded execution; collaborator-only new full formal runs.

limitations: R68 is development evidence; no semantic cause localized.
R65 statistics are gold-conditioned and common to classical controls.
No newcandidate model, circuit, feature probe or task utility execution.
Known entity-aware/bilinear mechanisms give high novelty collision risk.
